candidates.reason: Puts the headline on one line, which suits the banner, and keeps the colours and type. But the whole text block sits high (about 12px from the top, about 35px of empty space below), so it looks top-heavy. The headline is small for a 728x90 and only slightly wider than the orange brand line, so the hierarchy is weak. Most of the left and right width is empty.

Pixel-identical to candidate 1 with the same flaws: the block is pushed toward the top edge with dead space underneath, the headline is undersized compared with the brand line, and wide empty margins make it look like a small centred card rather than a layout made for a leaderboard.

Keeps the original two-line headline rhythm and gives 'Sip at sunset.' strong emphasis, so the hierarchy is clear. But three stacked lines are jammed into 90px with about 8px of margin top and bottom. The orange brand line has shrunk to tiny caps that are hard to read. A narrow centred column ignores the horizontal format of the banner.
